entities.name: Query catalase-peroxidase
observations: 758-aa sequence; estimated molecular mass 84.15 kDa and theoretical pI 8.13.
Strong homology supports bifunctional catalase-peroxidase activity; closest curated hit Q471D2 has 75.5% identity and 95.6% query coverage.
Sequence contains two Pfam peroxidase domains: PF00141 at residues 96–403 and 474–715.
Curated homologs are annotated with heme b cofactor and cytosolic localization; these are homology-based inferences for the query.

entities.name: Q471D2 catalase-peroxidase
observations: Reviewed Cupriavidus pinatubonensis catalase-peroxidase 1; 75.5% sequence identity to query at 95.6% query coverage.
Annotated as a heme-b-dependent enzyme with catalase and broad-spectrum peroxidase activity (EC 1.11.1.21); cytosolic annotation.
